title: Marion bar Avin (or Ravin)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: English translation and editorial notes prepared for Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He lived in the time of Rav Ashi, as in [Moed Katan 11b](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.11b.12), where it is related: “Marion son of Ravin and Mar son of Rav Acha son of Rava had a certain camel jointly”—Rav Ashi said, etc. And in [Bava Batra 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.26a.2): “When the household of Mar Marion son of Ravin were beating flax, the flax waste would fly about and harm people; they came before Ravina,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: Moed Katan names Marion son of Ravin. The consulted Bava Batra has “the household of bar Marion son of Ravin” where Hyman reads “the household of Mar Marion.”
